tasks.title: Implement JWT token service (Session Authentication)
tasks.description:
Create a token service that issues signed JWTs with configurable
expiry, refresh tokens, and revocation via a deny list. Use
HMAC-SHA256 with a server-generated secret or RSA key pair.

tasks.title: Wire session auth into middleware (Session Authentication)
tasks.description:
Replace the TODO stub in auth.go session mode with real JWT
validation. Extract claims, map to roles (Admin, Approver,
Viewer), and populate request context.

tasks.title: Add login and logout API endpoints (Session Authentication)
tasks.description:
POST /api/auth/login (credentials → JWT + refresh token),
POST /api/auth/refresh (refresh → new JWT),
POST /api/auth/logout (revoke tokens).
Rate-limit login attempts.

tasks.title: Add session auth test coverage (Session Authentication)
tasks.description:
Unit tests for token service (issue, validate, refresh, revoke).
Integration tests for login flow, expired tokens, role mapping,
and rate limiting. Target 90%+ coverage on auth package.

tasks.title: Add OIDC provider configuration (OIDC / SSO Integration)
tasks.description:
Extend DashboardAuthConfig with OIDC fields: issuer URL,
client ID, client secret, redirect URI, scopes, and claim
mappings. Support discovery via .well-known/openid-configuration.

tasks.title: Implement OIDC authorization code flow (OIDC / SSO Integration)
tasks.description:
Add /api/auth/oidc/login (redirect to IdP), /api/auth/oidc/callback
(exchange code for tokens, create session). Validate ID tokens,
extract claims, map groups to roles.

tasks.title: Map OIDC claims to Relicta roles (OIDC / SSO Integration)
tasks.description:
Configurable claim-to-role mapping (e.g., groups claim "relicta-admins"
→ Admin role). Support multiple IdPs with independent mappings.
Fallback to default Viewer role for unmapped users.

tasks.title: Test OIDC flows and document setup (OIDC / SSO Integration)
tasks.description:
Integration tests with a mock OIDC provider. Document IdP setup
for Okta, Azure AD, and Google Workspace with example configs.

tasks.title: Define persistence port interface (Database Persistence Layer)
tasks.description:
Extract a clean port interface from the file event store adapter.
Both file-based and PostgreSQL adapters implement the same interface.
Use the repository pattern from the existing hexagonal architecture.

tasks.title: Implement PostgreSQL adapter (Database Persistence Layer)
tasks.description:
Implement the persistence port using sqlc for type-safe query
generation with pgx as the driver. Store events in an append-only
events table with JSONB payload. Add indexes for release ID,
timestamp, and event type. Use connection pooling.

tasks.title: Add database migration framework (Database Persistence Layer)
tasks.description:
Embed SQL migrations via go:embed. Support up/down migrations
with version tracking. Add `relicta db migrate` and
`relicta db status` CLI commands. Use golang-migrate or similar.

tasks.title: Add persistence configuration (Database Persistence Layer)
tasks.description:
Extend config schema with persistence section: backend type
(file, postgres), connection string (with env var expansion),
pool size, migration mode (auto, manual). Wire adapter selection
in container setup.

tasks.title: Add persistence layer tests (Database Persistence Layer)
tasks.description:
Unit tests with interface mocks. Integration tests with testcontainers
for PostgreSQL. Test migration up/down, concurrent writes, event
replay, and failover to file-based when DB is unreachable.

tasks.title: Capture analytics events (Analytics Persistence)
tasks.description:
Emit structured analytics events for: risk evaluations, policy
decisions, approval outcomes, release durations, bump types.
Store via the persistence port (file or PostgreSQL).

tasks.title: Add analytics query endpoints (Analytics Persistence)
tasks.description:
GET /api/analytics/risk-trends (time-series risk scores),
GET /api/analytics/decisions (policy decision distribution),
GET /api/analytics/team (approvals per actor, release velocity).
Support date range and granularity parameters.

tasks.title: Implement analytics aggregation (Analytics Persistence)
tasks.description:
Pre-aggregate metrics for dashboard performance: daily/weekly/monthly
rollups for risk scores, decision counts, release frequency.
For file backend, aggregate on read. For PostgreSQL, use
materialized views or scheduled aggregation.

tasks.title: Add analytics test coverage (Analytics Persistence)
tasks.description:
Unit tests for event capture and aggregation logic. Integration
tests for query endpoints with seeded data. Verify both file
and PostgreSQL backends produce consistent results.

tasks.title: Add API versioning (REST API Hardening)
tasks.description:
Prefix all API routes with /api/v1/. Add version negotiation
via Accept header. Document versioning policy (additive changes
in minor, breaking changes in major).

tasks.title: Add pagination and filtering to list endpoints (REST API Hardening)
tasks.description:
Cursor-based pagination for releases, events, and audit trail
endpoints. Support limit, cursor, sort, and filter query params.
Return Link headers and pagination metadata in response body.

tasks.title: Generate OpenAPI specification (REST API Hardening)
tasks.description:
Annotate handlers with OpenAPI metadata. Generate spec at build
time or serve at /api/v1/openapi.json. Include authentication
schemes, error responses, and example payloads.

tasks.title: Implement structured error responses (REST API Hardening)
tasks.description:
Standardize error format: {code, message, details, request_id}.
Map domain errors to HTTP status codes consistently. Add
request ID middleware for correlation.

tasks.title: Add API contract tests (REST API Hardening)
tasks.description:
Integration tests verifying pagination, error formats, versioning,
and OpenAPI spec accuracy. Use golden file tests for response
shapes. Target full endpoint coverage.

tasks.title: Add persistent webhook delivery queue (Webhook Delivery Hardening)
tasks.description:
Queue webhook deliveries for async processing. Persist pending
deliveries so they survive restarts. Process in order per
endpoint with configurable concurrency.

tasks.title: Implement retry with exponential backoff (Webhook Delivery Hardening)
tasks.description:
Retry failed deliveries with exponential backoff and jitter.
Respect Retry-After headers. Move to dead-letter after max
retries. Log all delivery attempts with status codes.

tasks.title: Add webhook delivery log (Webhook Delivery Hardening)
tasks.description:
Log delivery attempts with timestamp, endpoint, status code,
response time, and payload hash. Expose via
GET /api/v1/webhooks/:id/deliveries. Support manual re-delivery.

tasks.title: Add webhook delivery tests (Webhook Delivery Hardening)
tasks.description:
Unit tests for queue, retry logic, and backoff calculation.
Integration tests with httptest server simulating failures,
slow responses, and redirects.
